scientific_integrity: Complete symbolic proof and standalone finite-field checks are provided; finite checks are corroboration, not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional vector spaces over fields; order formula only for finite fields. No assertions about arbitrary rings, infinite-dimensional spaces, or larger partial-automorphism monoids. Historical priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Factorizability and exact order of partial inner automorphisms of full linear monoids
